title: Owner reassigns a lead technician on Board View using only the keyboard and focus returns to the board
custom_preconds:
Signed in as Admin (can edit work orders), viewport 1280 px or wider; browser pinned to the fixture workplace
Saved Work Orders view reset over the API, then technicians A and B pinned in that saved preference
A throwaway customer with a unique name and no pinned note
Two work orders for that customer, each with one line, lead technician A, not Invoiced or Paid, and no scheduled shifts
B is an eligible lead technician whose name matches no other technician when searched

custom_steps_separated.content: Open Work Orders, pick Board View and search for the unique customer
custom_steps_separated.expected: Unassigned shows 0, A's column shows both cards, B's column shows 0

custom_steps_separated.content: Focus New work order and press Tab
custom_steps_separated.expected: Focus enters the board on the Unassigned column header
Focus moves to A's column header, then to A's first card
Focus moves to the card's More actions, and the menu opens with focus on Reassign lead technician
The Reassign lead technician dialog opens with the search field focused and A selected
The dialog closes, nothing changes, and focus is back on the card's More actions
The menu and then the dialog reopen, with A selected and the search empty

custom_steps_separated.content: Type B's name, press Tab, then ArrowDown
custom_steps_separated.expected: Only Unassigned and B are listed, and B is selected and focused

custom_steps_separated.content: Press Tab twice to reach Reassign and press Enter
custom_steps_separated.expected: "Lead technician updated" shows, the dialog closes, the card moves to B's column, and the counts read A 1 and B 1
The other card, still in A's column, has focus
The card is in B's column and the other card is still in A's column
